record.field: SELECT DISTINCT a.aufnr, a.auart, d.matnr, pt.priokx, qm.qmtxt, fe.fetxt, d.bdmng, f.bwart FROM aufk a LEFT JOIN afih b ON a.mandt=b.mandt AND a.aufnr=b.aufnr LEFT JOIN resb d ON a.mandt=d.mandt AND a.aufnr=d.aufnr LEFT JOIN makt e ON d.mandt=e.mandt AND e.matnr=d.matnr INNER JOIN mseg f ON a.mandt=f.mandt AND a.aufnr=f.aufnr AND f.matnr=d.matnr LEFT JOIN qmel qm ON a.mandt=qm.mandt AND a.aufnr=qm.aufnr LEFT JOIN viqmfe fe ON qm.mandt=fe.mandt AND qm.qmnum=fe.qmnum JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt=b.mandt AND pt.priok=b.priok AND pt.spras='E' AND pt.artpr='PM' WHERE f.bwart IN ('Z61','Z62') AND (f.bwart='Z62' OR (f.bwart='Z61' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mseg x WHERE x.mandt=f.mandt AND x.aufnr=f.aufnr AND x.matnr=f.matnr AND x.bwart='Z62')))

select a.aufnr,a.auart,b.equnr,il.tplnr, d.matnr, pt.priokx, qm.qmtxt,d.bdmng, afk.gstrp, a.werks from aufk a left join afih b on a.mandt = b.mandt and a.aufnr = b.aufnr left join resb d on a.mandt = d.mandt and a.aufnr = d.aufnr left join makt e on d.mandt = e.mandt and e.matnr = d.matnr left join mseg f on a.mandt = f.mandt and a.aufnr = f.aufnr left join qmel qm on a.mandt = qm.mandt and a.aufnr = qm.aufnr join t356_t pt on pt.mandt = b.mandt and pt.priok = b.priok and pt.spras = 'E' and pt.artpr = 'PM' left join iloa il on il.iloan = b.iloan left join afko afk on afk.aufnr = a.aufnr where a.auart = 'ZM04'
